plugins.name: business-manager
plugins.description: Runs the day-to-day operations of an AI education agency — content, campaigns, education/community, and client work — with persistent state in a shared _business-memory folder (local, Drive-synced, or any other cloud-synced location, found via BUSINESS_MEMORY_PATH) any agent can read for recurring client/campaign/positioning/resource-location context, plus business-manager's own private config and working files namespaced within it.

plugins.name: personal-assistant
plugins.description: Keeps a running record of how the owner thinks — ideas, reasoning, how they approach what they're building — in a shared, plugin-agnostic memory folder any agent can read (found via AGENT_MEMORY_PATH) and act from. Not an operations log — extensible with new log fields and capabilities over time.
